summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto standard in 2026 for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and APIs through a unified interface. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle hundreds of integrations, gateways that proxy and secure MCP traffic at scale, and individual servers that expose specific services like GitHub, browsers, or design files. MCP matters because it lets AI agents take real-world actions and read live context without bespoke integrations, turning LLMs into practical autonomous workers.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators bundle many MCP servers behind one managed endpoint (e.g. Composio, Smithery), gateways proxy/secure/route MCP traffic between clients and servers (e.g. Cloudflare, Kong), and individual servers each expose one specific tool or service (e.g. GitHub, Playwright).

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search, and repo management
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans (Free, Team, Enterprise)
strengths: Deep coverage of repo, PR, and issue workflows
Massive adoption across Cursor, Claude, and VS Code
tools.best_for: Automating repository, PR, and issue workflows directly from an AI agent

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web navigation, scraping, and end-to-end test runs
strengths: Enables agents to browse and test the live web
Backed by Microsoft and the Playwright team
tools.best_for: Giving agents browser automation and web testing capabilities

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps including Gmail, Slack, Jira, Notion, GitHub, Linear via one managed MCP layer
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based and team plans starting around $49/mo
strengths: Rube MCP universal endpoint for agents
tools.best_for: Connecting an agent to many SaaS tools without building each integration

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting, OAuth, and secure proxying on Cloudflare Workers
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans from $5/mo plus usage
strengths: Easy remote MCP hosting and deployment
tools.best_for: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers at scale

tools.name: Figma MCP (Dev Mode MCP Server)
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, variables, and Dev Mode context for code generation
tools.best_for: Turning Figma designs into code with AI coding agents

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of hosted and discoverable MCP servers via a registry and deployment platform
tools.best_for: Discovering, hosting, and installing MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content for reading and writing
strengths: Strong for knowledge base and docs context
Widely used in agent note-taking workflows
tools.best_for: Letting agents read and update Notion docs and databases

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and project management on Supabase
strengths: Query and schema management from agents
tools.best_for: Giving agents direct access to Postgres and backend data

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Community directory of thousands of MCP servers for discovery and comparison
tools.best_for: Browsing and finding MCP servers across the ecosystem

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Container lifecycle, images, and the Docker MCP Catalog/Toolkit for running MCP servers in containers
strengths: Official Docker MCP Catalog and Toolkit
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments, customers, invoices, and billing operations via agent toolkit
tools.pricing_paid: Free server; Stripe charges standard transaction fees
tools.best_for: Enabling agents to manage payments and billing

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error monitoring, issues, traces, and performance data from Sentry projects
strengths: Lets agents triage and debug errors
tools.best_for: Letting agents investigate and triage application errors
